lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice vill plus infinitive for simple wants and preferences.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Choosing fika or lunch with a colleague.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Saying what you want and asking what someone else wants.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik decide what they want to drink or eat during a break, with one polite refusal and one alternative.

main_focus.name: vill plus infinitive
main_focus.description: Use vill before an infinitive to express wants in simple everyday choices.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use vill plus infinitive naturally 4-5 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use concrete food and drink choices so vill appears in realistic short turns.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks what the other wants for fika or lunch.
dialogue_shape.middle: They exchange preferences, say no politely once, and suggest an easy alternative.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on a simple choice.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat vill in both questions and statements

focus: what each speaker wants to drink or eat
what one speaker does not want

sentence_focus: one negative sentence with vill inte
